Definition: from G1088; the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin:--senate.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gerousía means senate. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I read gerousía plainly: senate, and I leave it there.
